name: WireGuard
author: Logan <logan@fireflysoftware.dev>
description: WireGuard toggle and tunnel statistics in the Omarchy bar, driven by NetworkManager.

barWidget.description: Tunnel state in the bar; endpoint, routes, and transfer stats in a popup.

schema.label: NetworkManager connection
schema.description: Name of the WireGuard connection profile, as shown by `nmcli connection show`. Leave empty to use whichever WireGuard connection exists — set it only when you have more than one.

schema.label: Fallback poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: State changes arrive instantly via `nmcli monitor`; this is the safety-net poll, and the sampling rate for live throughput while the panel is open.

schema.label: Latency probe address
schema.description: Address pinged while the panel is open to measure round-trip time through the tunnel — usually the server's VPN address, e.g. 10.0.0.1. Empty (the default) hides the latency row.
